description.zh: 证书ID，多个证书ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为[ListUserCertificateOrder](~~455804~~)返回的**CertificateId**。
description.en: The ID of the certificate. Separate multiple certificate IDs with commas (,). You can call the [ListUserCertificateOrder](~~455804~~) operation to obtain the IDs of certificates from the **CertificateId** parameter.

description.zh: 联系人ID。多个联系人ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为[ListContact](~~2712221~~)返回的主键**Id**。
description.en: The ID of the contact. Separate multiple contact IDs with commas (,). You can call the [ListContact](~~2712221~~) operation to obtain the IDs of contacts from the **ContactId** parameter.

The type of the deployment task.

Valid values:

*   cloud: multi-cloud deployment task.
*   user: cloud service deployment task. This type of task does not support cloud servers.
The name of the deployment task.

description.zh: 云产品资源ID。多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为[ListCloudResources](~~2712230~~)返回的主键**Id**。
description.en: The ID of the cloud resource. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,). You can call the [ListCloudResources](~~2712230~~) operation to obtain the IDs of cloud resources from the **Id** parameter.

description.zh: 设置任务开始调度的时间（Unix时间戳）。如果不设置，在任务处于待执行状态时将立即执行部署。
description.en: The time when the task starts. The value is a UNIX timestamp. If you do not specify this parameter, the system immediately starts the task after the task is in the pending state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cas create-deployment-job --name jobName --job-type user --cert-ids 12342649,12304338,12067351,9957285 --resource-ids 6591316,6585549,6190248,5811894,5775176,5772504 --contact-ids 1,2 --schedule-time 1706613560008 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
